summary: Motion continuity across typing, panels and Emoji Search

changes.title: Interruptible keyboard panel motion
changes.detail: Retarget shared public controls from their last drawn blended artwork with bounded momentum; include Clipboard bottom-row controls without capturing clipboard contents. Keep the base opaque.

changes.title: Emoji Search glyph continuity
changes.detail: Match complete emoji strings; retain stationary glyphs and animate changed glyphs within native tap slots, with stable empty/pending states.

changes.title: Faster optional popups and key feedback
changes.detail: Keep existing preview preference; reuse a repeated character’s fading preview, bound unrelated exits, shorten entry/release and reveal long-press popups without moving touch coordinates.

changes.title: Swipe, Shift and trackpad refinements
changes.detail: Coalesce display-synchronized trail updates with eased taper and rounded tip; settle letter and Shift labels and synchronize trackpad labels and footer.

changes.title: Clipboard accessory continuity
changes.detail: Retarget the public compact icon from its previous position without retaining clipboard content or shifting prediction targets.
